title: Reserved exchange identifiers can be admitted as answerable
description: ExchangeLedger::admit accepts peer-supplied 0 and negative ExchangeId values even though 0 is CONNECTION_EXCHANGE and negative identifiers can never be minted. Answers on 0 are then misclassified as connection-wide. Acceptance: ExchangeFault gains Unanswerable carrying the offending ExchangeId; admit refuses every ID below FIRST_EXCHANGE before capacity/duplicate checks; 0, negative and positive regressions cross the intended boundary; generated schema is fresh; signal major version and upgrade note reflect the contract addition; full flake checks pass.
close_reason: ExchangeLedger now refuses IDs below one as typed Unanswerable faults; zero/negative/positive regressions and full flake check green.
